objective: Define a deterministic, fail-closed E1 parser contract before any bulk 356/356 execution, so canonicalization cannot silently change mathematical meaning.

parser_contract.totality_requirement: Every one of the 356 E0 representatives must receive exactly one disposition record during the later bulk run.
parser_contract.determinism_requirement: Identical E0 input bytes under the declared parser version must yield identical normalized AST serialization or identical typed failure code.
parser_contract.semantic_guard: Lexical or syntactic normalization is allowed only where meaning is invariant under the declared grammar; domain assumptions, units, branch choices and algebraic equivalence are not inferred at E1.

canonicalization_rules.rule: Ignore non-semantic whitespace outside identifiers and literals.
canonicalization_rules.boundary: Does not reorder operands or terms.

canonicalization_rules.rule: Normalize the Unicode radical token √ applied to one syntactic atom into an explicit sqrt(atom) AST node.
canonicalization_rules.boundary: If radical extent is not syntactically unambiguous, emit TYPED_PARSE_FAILURE instead of guessing.

canonicalization_rules.rule: Preserve operator order, explicit grouping and relation direction exactly as parsed.
canonicalization_rules.boundary: No commutative sorting, simplification, cancellation or constant folding is permitted in E1.

canonicalization_rules.rule: Treat absolute-value bars only when a complete balanced syntactic span is recognized.
canonicalization_rules.boundary: Unbalanced or overloaded bars must fail closed.

canonicalization_rules.rule: Preserve identifier spelling as observed after Unicode NFC.
canonicalization_rules.boundary: No synonym, variable-renaming, unit inference or semantic aliasing is permitted.
